ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the fate of disbelievers in the Fire on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Muddaththir is often linked to the concept of 'Fitnah' (trial) as a purifying or punitive exposure to divine wrath, emphasizing the tangible reality of the Hereafter. It underscores the finality of divine retribution for those who rejected the Prophet's message, serving as a warning to the faithful about the consequences of disbelief.
